player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Mbeni zo ti pikango mozoko atara ti yeda na mbeni ye so a gbanzi ni sân ti wara aye kue.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lokuta {player_id}, Sika nzonzi. Kolóná {col} ezali kozala na mabe.
invalid_move.already_full: Lokuta {player_id}, Sika nzonzi. Kolóná {col} ezali na mabe.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Player {player_id} tried to make a trade offer without having the necessary resources.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Zo ti pikango ye {player_id} amû mbeni mbeti so a sû na lege ni pëpe.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Zo ti pikango ye {player_id} amû mbeni fini matabisi pëpe.

offers.reject: Mbeni zo ti pikango ndembo {player_id} ake na lo ye so a mû ni.
offers.proposal: Lokuta {player_id} akeli lisolo oyo na lokuta {opponent_id}: Makambi ebongisi: {offered} -> Makambi emonani: {requested}

outcome.win: Zo ti pikango ye {winner_id} awara na lege so lo wara kota ngele mingi ahon.
outcome.draw: A yeke changé ngere ti aye kue gi oko tongaso na yâ ti azo so ayeke sara ngia.
